II. INTRODUCTION  
 
 
A. PURPOSE OF THIS REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL 
 
Santa Fe County (SFC) desires to contract with multiple firms  with fire safety and 
engineering expertise to provide a technical review specific to Battery Energy Storage 
Systems (BESS), specifically to  include lithium-ion and /or other battery storage 
technologies. Offerors must be knowledgeable with BESS fire protection requirements  as 
well as the BESS installation, commission ing and decommissioning.  Having multiple 
contracts with qualified consultants in this field of expertise will ensure timely review of 
development applications for the County. 
             
B. BACKGROUND 
 
The Growth Management Department is responsible that all private and public 
developments that are proposed to be constructed within Santa Fe County boundaries are 
in compliance with the County’s Sustainable Land Development Code (SLDC).  The 
Department receives multiple applications from Developers that contain development and 
design specifications and plans for the construction of solar facilities in Santa Fe County 
that involve Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). Due to this emerging technology the 
County requires engineering services with fire safety expertise to ensure that the proposed 
plans conform with the SLDC . The consultants will be required to review final 
construction drawings for each proposed development and report any and all compliance 
variances or issues with the development plans to Growth Management and County Fire 
Compliance Officers.   
 
C. SCOPE OF WORK  
 
The firm selected shall provide the following services: 
 
1. Review and ensure compliance with applicable codes, including but not limited to the 
following: 
a) Santa Fe County Ordinances 2023-06 and 2023-09 or current 
b) Current International Fire Code (IFC) 
c) Current International Wildland Urban Interface Code (IWUIC) 
d) Current National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) 855 Standard 
e) Current Santa Fe County Sustainable Land Development Code (SLDC) 
 
2. Review application for Conditional Use Permit (CUP) to determine completeness of 
application, including: 
a) Review of applicable studies, as required by staff. 
b) Conduct research necessary to substantiate staff’s recommendation. 
c) Review proposed location and features of BESS and preliminary site plan.

RFP No. 2026-0385-GM/JP  
 
 
6 
 
 
d) Attend at least two public hearings to provide expert testimony on proposed project 
design, technology and safety features.  
 
3. Review BESS submittal, and required re-submittals, in accordance with IFC, NFPA 
855, and other applicable codes and standards for compliance, accuracy, and overall 
safety, included but not limited to the following: 
a) Fire and explosion testing data. 
b) Hazard Mitigation Plan. 
c) Calculations or modeling data to determine compliance with NFPA 68 and 69. 
d) Other test data, evaluation information, or calculations required by NFPA 855. 
e) Emergency Operations and Response Plans. 
f) Pre-Incident Plan. 
g) Smoke and gas plume analysis. 
h) Construction plans, technical data and information provided by applicant. 
i) Compliance with applicable local, state and federal codes. 
j) Commissioning plan and testing reports 
k) Fire protection measures and technologies applicable to lithium-io and other types of 
storage systems.  
l) Thermal runaway causes and their mitigation.

C. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS

 3. Prime Contractor Responsibility 
 
  Any contract that may result from this RFP shall specify that the prime contractor is 
solely responsible for fulfillment of the contract with the County. The County will

responsible for the performance of the contract with the County whether or not subcon-
tractors are used.

proposals.  Such amended proposal must be a complete replacement of the previously 
submitted proposal and must be clearly identified as such in the transmit tal letter.  
County personnel will not merge, collate, or assemble proposal materials.

b) Response to County Terms and Conditions
